description: e-Court project of the implementation of Digital Transformation of the Court System in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government has identified the digitalization of the court system in Sri Lanka as a national priority initiative. As the initial step in the digital transformation process, the Supreme Court has successfully launched and implemented a Web Portal integrating an eCase Management System (e-CMS) by now. Through the 'e-Court' project it is anticipated that the Web Portal and e-CMS developed for the Supreme Court would be adapted and used by all courts across the island, including the Court of Appeal, the Judicial Service Commission, and the Judges’ Institute. It is planned to establish a National Judicial Data Grid, which will overcome the long-standing problems of case delays, lack of data transparency, and procedural inefficiencies that hinder timely access to justice faced by the judicial system of the country. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to allocate provisions amounting to Rs.150 million to the Judicial Service Commission for the implementation of the 'e Court' project from the provisions allocated under the 'Clean Sri Lanka' project effectively and efficiently, in line with the Reform Agenda of the International Monetary Fund, Public Investment Programme 2026-2030 and the 'Clean Sri Lanka' strategy, was approved by the Cabinet.
